about_the_game:
Pair-A-Dice is a surreal strategy game about cards, dice, and bending the rules of reality. You discover yourself as a player with rare power, giving you advantage over most others. Guided by a mysterious companion, you'll roll your way through fractured worlds and intimidating enemies, learning how even a losing hand can be played to win.

The core of the game is painfully simple: roll two dice. If their total matches the number of a card on your side, you can send it over to your opponent's side. First to get rid of them all wins.

Despite the simplicity, each enemy has their own philosophy about how the game should be played, and they’ll twist the rules to prove their point. Whether it’s freezing your dice, setting them on fire or turning the whole board against you, every battle is a unique challenge in control, manipulation, and memory.

With expressive animation, reactive dialogue, and layered world-building told through echoed memories, Pair-A-Dice is a mind-bending fusion of chance, control, and character.

content_descriptors.notes:
Pair-A-Dice contains stylized battles and surreal character interactions that may include references to emotional distress, manipulation, or obsessive behavior. Certain characters personify abstract concepts such as addiction, vanity, and control, and their stories may touch on darker themes such as regret, self-isolation, or psychological breakdown. All content is presented in a symbolic, non-graphic style.
There is no explicit sexual content, gore, or depictions of real-world drug use. However, some imagery and dialogue may not be suitable for younger audiences.
